description: Source code for the Firefox browser implementation in Playwright, including classes for browser connection, context, and page management, with methods for browser control, context setup, and event handling.

classes.name: FFBrowser
classes.description: Represents a Firefox browser instance, manages sessions, contexts, and pages, and handles browser-level events and connections.

classes.name: FFBrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context in Firefox, manages page creation, cookies, permissions, and context-specific settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Firefox browser instance over a transport, initializes browser state.

methods.name: _initVersion
methods.description: Retrieves and stores the browser version and user agent.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Returns a list of current browser contexts.

methods.name: _onDetachedFromTarget
methods.description: Handles the event when a target (page) is detached.

methods.name: _onAttachedToTarget
methods.description: Handles the event when a target (page) is attached.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles browser disconnection, cleans up pages and videos.
